RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the November 15, 2007/Kartika 24, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and
Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport
and Highways; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation;
Urban Development; Youth
Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
1
New sports policy
*1. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated a new sports policy taking into
consideration the poor infrastructure for
the development of Indian sports,
particularly hockey, football, wrestling and
kabaddi etc. at the grassroot level;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the share of central assistance to be
provided to the States for the purpose;
(c) whether the new sports policy has
not so far been formulated; and
(d) by when that is likely to be done?
Nuclear deal
*2. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether our agreement on nuclear
deal is being implemented by Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken so far by
Government in this direction?
River bridges in Orissa on NH-5(A)
*3. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the river
bridges on the NH-5(A) in Orissa State,
have sounded a warning of possible collapse
on account of heavy traffic; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
inter alia the action plan of Government
to strengthen all the river bridges on this
highway to meet with the increased
traffic?

2
Highways taken up in Andhra Pradesh
*4. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the highways taken up during the
last three years in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) the details thereof, highway-wise;
(c) the recommendations pending with
the Union Government from the State
Government of Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) the action taken thereon?
Renting of SIMs
*5. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether cellular service providers in
the country are found to be renting out
SIMs to users whose identities the service
providers are not aware of;
(b) the numbers of SIMs issued by each
of the service providers;
(c) the punishment/fine imposed,
prosecutions launched, if any, on such
defaulters; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
curb the menace?
US sanctions on Iran
*6. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
SHRI D. RAJA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the US sanctions imposed
on Iran; and
(b) if so, the details and Government's
reaction thereto?
IHSDP in Cuttack
*7. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to develop
infrastructure in Cuttack under the
Integrated Housing and Slum Development
Programme (IHSDP), a centrally funded
project;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Centre has also
promised to resolve various other problems
of slum dwellers in Orissa; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
World Bank loan for Panchayati Raj
System
*8. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the efforts of his Ministry
to get Rs. 4,000 crore loan from the World
Bank to strengthen the Panchayati Raj
System in the country have succeeded;
(b) if so, the details of the plan charted
out to utilize the above loan;
(c) whether any emphasis would be
given in the plan for development of
Panchayati Raj System in backward
districts, particularly in Andhra Pradesh;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether the Ministry has realized
the importance of taking 'Block' as a unit
instead of the existing parameter of taking

3
'District' as a unit, as a result of which even
if 25% of the district is backward it is not
able to reap the benefit of schemes and
remaining backward for a longer time?
Encroachment  of forest land by land
mafia
*9. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the guidelines fixed by Government
to reclaim the forest land which has been
illegally encroached by the land mafia;
(b) whether it is a fact that a large chunk
of Government forest land was illegally
encroached by land mafia in Himachal
Pradesh particularly in Jubbal-Katkhai,
Rohru and Chirgaon tehsil; and
(c) if so, the action being contemplated
by Government in this regard against the
land mafia and concerned officials who are
involved in this nexus with them?
Medicinal plants
†*10. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the steps taken by his
Ministry for conservation of medicinal
plants during the last three years, State-
wise;
(b) the details of the amount spent
under the head during the said period, State-
wise;
(c) the details of the financial assistance/
grant/help provided to Government and
Non-Government Organisations for
conservation of medicinal plants, State-wise
and organisation-wise; and
(d) the details of amount to be spent
during the financial year 2007-08, State-
wise?
Panchayati Raj institutions
and SHGs
*11. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of P ANCHAYATI RAJ be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are evolving a
scheme, with co-operation of World Bank
for federating self-help groups (SHGs) into
Panchayati Raj institutions to organize
women from poor and disadvantaged rural
households to make them vibrant and self-
sufficient;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government have
developed any mechanism to periodically
monitor working of Panchayati Raj outfits?
Improvement of delivery system
*12. SHRIMATI  PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI  SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are working
fast to introduce a new technology driven
integrated smart card system that would
improve delivery systems and bridge the
gap between target and achievements for
various schemes;
(b) whether the World Bank's recent
report "Doing Business in 2007" which
points out that India stood at a low of 173
of the 175 countries has been studied under
the parameter of executing contracts;
(c) whether Government have
constituted a committee to find out ways
to improve delivery system and have also
received its recommendations; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to implement
them?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

4
Postal Life Insurance Scheme
*13. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the loss of faith of common people in the
Postal Life Insurance Scheme due to non-
settlement of death claims;
(b) whether Government have received
representations/request for settlement of
policy series DL-34825-CS;
(c) if so, the reasons for non- settlement
of the claims;
(d) by when these claims are likely to
be settled to restore investor faith; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
State Transport Ministers' Meet
*14. SHRIMATI  SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI  SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Transport Ministers of all
States attended a meeting in New Delhi in
the month of September, 2007 to discuss
ways to ensure better inter-State
connectivity;
(b) if so, what were the main proposals
discussed;
(c) whether any final decision in
implementing these agreements were also
discussed; and
(d) to what extent all the State
Governments have agreed to implement the
suggestions taken in the meeting for better
road connectivity?
Vizhinjam Port Project
*15. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the stage of the proposal for
Vizhinjam Port Project in Trivandrum; and
(b) by when the work on this project is
expected to start and by when its
commercial operation is likely to
commence?
New licencing policy for telecom
operators
*16. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated a new policy with regard to the
issuing of new licences to telecom operators
and for the sale of Spectrum;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not,  by when the same is likely to
be formulated?
Waiver of bills of faulty telephones by
BSNL
*17. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether BSNL consumers have to
pay their telephone bills despite their
telephone connections remaining out of
order for months together;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;

5
(c) the details of provisions/guidelines/
orders in this regard; and
(d) whether Government would
consider to waive off dues of telephone
bills in cases where BSNL connections
remain out of order for more than 15 days
at a stretch?
Four-laning of NH-31A
*18. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have a
proposal to make NH-31A into a four lane
highway;
(b) if so, the total amount sanctioned
for the project;
(c) the portion of the NH likely to be
four laned during the year 2007-08; and
(d) the steps taken by Government in
this respect?
Long Term Vision of DAE
*19. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Long T erm Vision of
Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)
envisage production of 20,000 MW power
from nuclear source in the year 2020;
(b) if so, when was the Long Term
Vision framed;
(c) whether fuel supply and linkage for
the same was planned, accordingly;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reason therefor?
Terrorist infrastructure in Pakistan
*20. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI  SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether with intelligence reports
holding that the terrorist infrastructure in
Pakistan is still very much active and kicking
and infiltration is continuing at a large scale
and also for the first time China publicly
acknowledging the existence of terrorist
camps operating in Pakistan can India afford
to lower its guard;
(b) the latest position of infiltration of
Pakistanis into J&K; and
(c) whether this continued increased
infiltration has affected the on-going talks
held between India and Pakistan for
improving relations?
NEW DELHI; V. K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 12th November, 2007 Secretary-General.
Kartika 21, 1929 (Saka)

6
MGIPMRND—4373RS—10.11.2007.

(Ministry-wise)
